form.description: a sign-up form, with its title and introduction in doc

opens.description: first instant that takes sign-ups; absent means no opening limit

closes.description: first instant that no longer takes sign-ups; absent means no closing limit

capacity.description: maximum accepted registrations; absent means unlimited

closed.description: what the form says while it takes no sign-ups: before it opens, after it closes, or once it is full

notify.description: entity ids to notify of a sign-up

shares.description: a sign-up whose answer to question is this value is shared with the app's people: its shared answers are written to a shared row they read

question.description: one question belonging to a form; repeat children point at their containing question

choices.description: the offered values for choose or choices

within.description: the repeat question containing this question

when.description: show only when an earlier answer matches; look in the nearest repeat entry, then outer answers

fills.description: directory property filled by this answer, such as individual.born

relates.description: on a repeat, what each entry is to the person it is listed under; absent records no relation

shared.description: whether this answer is among those a shared sign-up shows the app's people

order.description: question order; absent is zero and ties sort by entity id

registration.description: one sign-up; answers are keyed by question id, with repeat groups holding arrays of answer objects; read only by the app's owners and editors

form.description: the form signed up through, retained as history

person.description: the person signing up, when identified

answers.description: answers keyed by question id; null skips an optional question; repeat answers are arrays of answer objects

submitter.description: platform person whose submission this is, independent of the matched directory person

shared.description: the answers a sign-up's sender chose to share, read by the app's viewers, editors and owners and nobody else; deleting the sign-up deletes it

registration.description: the sign-up whose answers these are

answers.description: the shared answers, keyed by question id

waitlisted.description: this registration is waiting for a place

by.description: who put it on the waitlist

via.description: the session or client that wrote the mark
